svg.title: An expense claim is checked twice before it is paid, and anything over the limit needs a director
svg.desc: Activity diagram with 4 partitions: Employee, Manager, Director, Finance. Start (Employee). Fill in claim (Employee). Attach receipts (Employee). Submit claim (Employee). Review claim (Manager). Valid? (Manager) [yes]: over limit? (Manager) (step 7). [needs changes]: correct claim (Employee) (step 8). Over limit? (Manager) [yes]: second review (Director) (step 9). [no]: audit receipts (Finance) (step 10). Correct claim (Employee). Second review (Director). Audit receipts (Finance). Approve? (Director) [yes]: audit receipts (Finance) (step 10). [no]: reject claim (Manager) (step 13). Receipts match? (Finance) [yes]: a fork (Finance) (step 14). [no]: reject claim (Manager) (step 13). Reject claim (Manager). At the same time: pay employee (Finance); record in ledger (Finance). Read decision (Employee). When both are done: send decision (Finance). End (Employee).
